content: The dataset is split into a multilingual training set and into multiple test sets to evaluate zero-shot cross-lingual and cross-target transfer. To provide a baseline, we fine-tune a multilingual Bert model BIBREF5 on x-stance. We show that the baseline accuracy is comparable to previous stance detection benchmarks while leaving ample room for improvement. In addition, multilingual Bert can generalize to a degree both cross-lingually and in a cross-target setting.
